title: ever FAYE|Elegant V-Neck Flowy High-Low Short Sleeve Wedding Guest Dress
descriptionHtml:
Step into elegance with this stylish dress featuring a flattering V-neck design and flowy high-low hem. Crafted from lightweight fabric, it drapes beautifully, allowing for ease of movement while creating a captivating silhouette. The short sleeves add a touch of sophistication, making it perfect for weddings and special occasions.


Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: High low


Sleeve Style: Short sleeves


Closure: It is concealed a zipper up the back


Undergarments: It is not padded, with lining


Fabric:The garment comprises chiffon


Stretch: Fabric is no stretch
